title: Cold start after a long outage

GT 1 AC lube oil pump fails

Load rejection with a stuck GT 1 fuel valve
GT 1 bearing 2 damage
GT 1 compressor surge
Fuel gas supply pressure falls
Generator 1 cooling fault
HP feedwater control valve fails open
HP feedwater control valve fails closed
Feedwater pump recirculation valve stuck closed
HP superheater spray valve stuck open
Steam turbine AC lube oil pump fails
Both steam turbine lube oil pumps fail
Load rejection with stuck steam turbine control valves
Steam turbine thrust bearing wear
Steam turbine bearing 3 damage
CW pump A motor overload
CW pumps A and B trip (a supply fault)
CW pump C discharge valve actuator fails
Cooling tower basin drain left open
Cooling tower fan 3 blade damage
Condensate leak with the hotwell makeup failed
